Cheers!

notes.title: Pretentious Game is now self published by Keybol Games!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I hope you are having a great time and enjoying the holiday seasons. I sure do! Anyway, one of the biggest changes that happened to me this year is the return of my game Pretentious Game to my developer account. Meaning my partnership with my publisher is done.

With that announcement, more chapters of Pretentious Game is coming this 2017!

Cheers!
